tables.title: Summary of device limitations
tables.text_helper: Table 3, "Summary of device limitations", on page 2 of Rev 8 in section 1 (Summary of device errata).

rows: Access permission faults are prioritized over unaligned device memory faults
LSE crystal oscillator may be disturbed by transitions on PC13
Peripheral triggers connected to RTC wakeup timer interrupt instead of RTC wakeup timer trigger signal
Incorrect behavior of ICACHE refill from SRAM when an SRAM AHB error occurs
Device cannot exit from Standby mode except by a power-on reset
SRAMx_RST option bits have an immediate effect
Additional consumption on PA11/PA12 in Stop and Standby modes
Product state change is not supported on early samples
Flash memory latency is increased during read-while-write (RWW) operation
Product state regression is not possible when data flash memory is enabled
Full JTAG configuration without NJTRST pin cannot be used
BOOT0 pin is sensitive to electrostatic discharge
Flash memory endurance is limited to 1 Kcycle
SRAM2 is erased when the backup domain is reset
Clearing IWDG_SW might result in debug authentication or STiRoT failure
Clearing WWDG_SW might result in debug authentication or STiRoT failure
LSE low drive mode is not functional
Read from flash memory may fail in VOS2 and VOS1 range
Partial regression may lead to incorrect device configuration
®Debug not available when TrustZone security is disabled and the PRODUCT_STATE is iROT-Provisioned
Incorrect flash memory configuration on 1 Mbyte devices
Reset vector catch feature cannot be used when debugging is disabled for secure code
Low-speed external clock in analog bypass mode might not work properly
Octo-SPI memory data failure when using HCLK as kernel clock
PLL1P output can unduly be disabled by software when used as SYSCLK clock
Ethernet active clock in Sleep mode control is missing
ADC and DAC clock selection cannot be secured when the ADC is nonsecure
Device ID (SoC ID) not available via the discovery function on STM32H562/563 devices
Invalid DAC output voltage for several DAC kernel clocks
LPTIM2_CH1 might prevent the system from entering low-power modes
CPU execution freeze upon first erase or program operation after power-on or wake-up from Standby
FDCAN TrustZone® and privilege protection misalignment with memory boundaries
Debug Authentication provisioning cannot be done from the application when TZEN is disabled
The SOC ID information is not available in Debug Authentication
Application binary with a specific sequence cannot be installed by STiRoT
STiRoT fails if a tamper event arises during the startup
Backup domain erased upon reset when STiRoT boot is active and the clock other than LSI selected
Tampers are not usable with STiRoT
Input hysteresis not properly enabled on PA1
Dummy read cycles inserted when reading synchronous memories
Wrong data read from a busy NAND memory
Memory-mapped write error response when DQS output is disabled
TCF set twice on an abort
Deadlock in clock mode 3 when prefetching the 64 upper memory bytes
Memory wrap instruction not enabled when DQS is disabled
Deadlock or write-data corruption after spurious write to a misaligned address in OCTOSPI_AR register
Deadlock on consecutive out-of-range memory-mapped write operations
Indirect write mode limited to 256 Mbytes
Read-modify-write operation does not clear the MSEL bit
Setting the ABORT bit does not generate an error on the AHB bus for undefined-length incremental burst transfers
Read data corruption when a wrap transaction is followed by a linear read to the same MSB address
Transactions are limited to 8 Mbytes in OctaRAM™ memories
Variable latency is not supported when a refresh collision occurs ™during a write access to some OctaRAM memories
Command response and receive data end bits not checked
New context conversion initiated without waiting for trigger when writing new context in ADC_JSQR with JQDIS = 0 and JQM = 0
Two consecutive context conversions fail when writing new context in ADC_JSQR just after previous context completion with JQDIS = 0 and JQM = 0
Unexpected regular conversion when two consecutive injected conversions are performed in Dual interleaved mode
Injected data stored in the wrong ADC_JDRx registers
ADC slave data may be shifted in Dual regular simultaneous mode
Slow discharge of the capacitor connected to VREF+ pin
Bidirectional break mode not working with short pulses
Timer connection to USB SOF might not work properly
Device may remain stuck in LPTIM interrupt when entering Stop mode
ARRM and CMPM flags are not set when APB clock is slower than kernel clock
Interrupt status flag is cleared by hardware upon writing its corresponding bit in LPTIM_DIER register
Overcapture stops working when CCxOF flag is cleared in some specific conditions
PLL2 output cannot be used as LPTIM clock source
Independent watchdog does not wake up the system from Stop mode
Alarm flag may be repeatedly set when the core is stopped in debug
Tamper event 15 raised when a system reset occurs
Timestamp flag unexpectedly raised when disabling timestamp
Wrong data sampling when data setup time (tSU;DAT) is shorter than one I2C kernel clock period
Spurious bus error detection in controller mode
SDA held low upon SMBus timeout expiry in target mode
2I3C controller: unexpected read data bytes during a legacy IC read
I3C controller: SCL clock is not stalled during address ACK/NACK phase following a frame start, when enabled through I3C_TIMINGR2 register
I3C controller: unexpected first frame with a 0x7F address when the I3C peripheral is enabled
I3C controller: no timestamp on IBI acknowledge when timing control is used in Asynchronous mode 0
Data corruption due to noisy receive line
USART does not generate DMA requests after setting/clearing DMAT bit
Wrong data received in smartcard mode and 0.5 stop bit configuration
Received data may be corrupted upon clearing the ABREN bit
Noise error flag set while ONEBIT is set
LPUART does not generate DMA requests after setting/clearing DMAT bit
Possible LPUART transmitter issue when using low BRR[15:0] value
RDY output failure at high serial clock frequency
Truncation of SPI output signals after EOT event
TIFRE flag wrongly set in slave PCM long frame mode if FIXCH = 1
TIFRE flag never set in slave PCM/I2S mode if FIXCH = 0
Desynchronization under specific condition with edge filtering enabled
Tx FIFO messages inverted under specific buffer usage and priority setting
Buffer description table update completes after CTR interrupt triggers
TXHRST upon write data underflow corrupting the CRC of the next packet
Ordered set with multiple errors in a single K-code is reported as invalid
The MAC does not provide bus access to a higher priority request after a low priority request is serviced
Rx DMA engine may fail to recover upon a restart following a bus error, with Rx timestamping enabled

Incorrectly weighted round robin arbitration between Tx and Rx DMA channels to access the common host bus
Incorrect L4 inverse filtering results for corrupted packets
IEEE 1588 Timestamp interrupt status bits are incorrectly cleared on write access to the CSR register with similar offset address

Incorrect flexible PPS output interval under specific conditions
Packets dropped in RMII 10 Mbps mode due to fake dribble and CRC error
Missed CEC messages in normal receiving mode
Unexpected TXERR flag during a message transmission

tables.title: Document revision history
tables.text_helper: Table 5, "Document revision history", on page 43 of Rev 8.

rows: Added STM32H563AG part number. Added Clearing IWDG_SW might result in debug authentication or STiRoT failure and Clearing WWDG_SW might result in debug authentication or STiRoT failure errata.

Added STM32H562xG part numbers in Table 1. Device summary. Updated LSE crystal oscillator may be disturbed by transitions on PC13 and changed status to 'N' for rev Z and X. Added LSE low drive mode is not functional, Read from flash memory may fail in VOS2 and VOS1 range, Partial regression may lead to incorrect device configuration, Incorrect backup domain reset, and Debug not available when TrustZone® security is disabled and the PRODUCT_STATE is iROT- Provisioned.

Table 3. Summary of device limitations: •Updated Peripheral triggers connected to RTC wakeup timer interrupt instead of RTC wakeup timer trigger signal status for revisions Z and X •Updated Clearing IWDG_SW might result in debug authentication or STiRoT failure status for revision X SYSTEM errata: added Incorrect flash memory configuration on 1 Mbyte devices, Reset vector catch feature cannot be used when debugging is disabled for secure code and Ethernet alternate functions not available on PB13 and PB14. OCTOSPI errata: added Memory-mapped write error response when DQS output is disabled. CEC errata: added Missed CEC messages in normal receiving mode and Unexpected TXERR flag during a message transmission.

Added SYSTEM errata •Low-speed external clock in analog bypass mode might not work properly •Octo-SPI memory data failure when using HCLK as kernel clock •PLL1P output can unduly be disabled by software when used as SYSCLK clock •Ethernet active clock in Sleep mode control is missing •ADC and DAC clock selection cannot be secured when the ADC is nonsecure •Device ID (SoC ID) not available via the discovery function on STM32H562/563 devices •Invalid DAC output voltage for several DAC kernel clocks •LPTIM2_CH1 might prevent the system from entering low-power modes

Updated Table 2. Device variants (device version W added) and Table 3. Summary of device limitations. Added SPI erratum RDY output failure at high serial clock frequency.
